g.text: Preciazo - Design-Level Event Storming: Merchant Management
AV2 Design Proposal - US21, US22, US24, US26; TS04, TS05, TS08
RUC, legal name and first store
Initial attempt or authorized PENDING retry
Store time zone and existing windows
Query-time opening status and promotion validity
Timeout is not fiscal rejection: keep PENDING.
Query-time validity removes expired promotions even when a job is late.
Catalog retains public base price; Inventory retains physical quantities.
Choose the fiscal provider and ownership-proof procedure.
Catalog price/availability coordination and promotion consumption are pending.
No ACL or cross-context domain dependency is introduced.
